results.question: 2025年每个月的GMV是多少
results.sql:
SELECT 
  d.year AS 年,
  d.month AS 月,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) AS GMV
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025 AND f.order_status != '已取消'
GROUP BY d.year, d.month
ORDER BY d.year, d.month;
